# Dentalink — Task Outline

## Template

- **New name:** Dentalink
- **Original:** ColorLib "Dentist" (https://colorlib.com/wp/template/dentist/)
- **Preview:** https://preview.colorlib.com/theme/dentist/

## Sections (in order)

1. Header — fixed white header with logo, phone/email bar, nav, social icons
2. Hero — dark overlay bg, "Authentic Dental Service", CTA "Get Started"
3. Opening Hours — white card, green dot, schedule table
4. Services — 4 cards: Preventive Care, Cosmetic Dentistry, Orthodontics, Dental Implants
5. About — dark bg, split layout, "Who we are to Serve the nation"
6. Testimonials — 3 cards with avatar, quote, name, title
7. Team — 4 members with hover overlay
8. Features — 6 items: Emergency, Consultation, X-Ray, Dental Science, Intensive Care, Family Planning
9. Appointment — form: patient name, phone, email, DOB, date, message
10. Blog — 4 cards with image, date, title, excerpt
11. Footer — dark bg, 3 columns, Component Dock link

## Design Tokens

- Brand green: #67bc00 (gradient #ade600→#62b900)
- Dark navy: #04091e
- Light bg: #f9f9ff
- Font: Poppins
- Buttons: rounded 25px primary, sharp CTA on banner
